schemaNotes.purpose: Master content catalog. Feed to Emergent as Firestore seed. Every story ships with full metadata, cast, and endings. Chapters are produced via the chapter generation pipeline (see chapter_generation_prompt.md) and inserted into chapters[] per story. Story s01 includes chapter 1 fully written as the canonical message-format reference plus a 30-chapter outline.
schemaNotes.portraitUrls: Placeholder paths. Admin AI pipeline generates 6 expressions per character (neutral, happy, flirty, angry, shocked, sad) and overwrites these.
schemaNotes.playerCharacter: senderCharacterId PLAYER renders the user's avatar. Player is the protagonist in every story.
schemaNotes.chapterRules: 30 chapters per story. Chapters 1-3 free and instant. 3-hour timer after. Every chapter ends on a cliffhanger. 2-4 choicePoints per chapter, exactly 1 premium (25 gems) per 2 chapters minimum. 4-6 scenePanels per story on key beats. Endings resolve in chapters 28-30 based on accumulated endingWeight.

stories.title: Texting Mr. Wrong
stories.synopsis: You texted your best friend to rant about your disaster date. Except that's not your best friend's number anymore. It belongs to Vihaan Malhotra, Mumbai's most unbothered billionaire, and he texted back.

characters.name: Vihaan
characters.bio: 29, tech billionaire, allergic to feelings, dangerously good at texting

characters.name: Zoya
characters.bio: Chaotic hype woman, zero filter, suspicious of rich men

characters.name: Kiara
characters.bio: Vihaan's elegant ex, back in the picture, plays chess with people

shareCardConfig.line: only {rarity}% of readers were delulu enough to get this ending

endings.name: Walked Away Rich in Self Respect

shareCardConfig.line: only {rarity}% of readers were delulu enough to get this ending
only {rarity}% of readers were delulu enough to get this ending

chapterOutline: 1. Wrong number rant lands in a stranger's inbox, he replies with a roast
2. Banter war escalates, he refuses to say who he is
3. Zoya investigates the number, finds nothing, suspicious
4. He guesses your coffee order from your texting style, first flutter
5. A news alert shows his face, you realize who he might be, he denies it
6. Premium branch: call him out vs play along
7. First voice note, Zoya screams, group chat meltdown
8. He goes cold for 48 hours, you spiral
9. He explains: board coup at his company, opens up for the first time
10. He asks to meet, panic, scene panel: staring at the mirror
11. The meeting, he is exactly and nothing like you imagined
12. Kiara appears at the cafe, marks territory
13. Zoya digs up Kiara and Vihaan's history
14. Premium branch: confront him about Kiara vs let it go
15. Gala invitation, closet crisis, makeover montage
16. Scene panel: the gala entrance, all eyes on you
17. Overheard conversation, sounds like you were a bet
18. Ghost him vs demand answers, major weight split
19. His grand explanation, the truth about the wrong number
20. Twist: it was never a wrong number. Zoya gave him your number
21. Fallout with Zoya, hardest chapter, friendship on the line
22. Vihaan takes accountability, first real apology of his life
23. Kiara's final move: leaked photos, PR crisis
24. Premium branch: stand beside him publicly vs protect yourself
25. His board demands he drop the scandal, meaning you
26. Scene panel: rooftop, the choice between his world and yours
27. You set your terms, he has never been spoken to like this
28. Weight resolution begins, three paths visibly diverge
29. Penultimate: the proposal, the goodbye, or the leap, per path
30. Ending chapter per accumulated endingWeight, ending scene panel

messages.text: ZOYA. emergency. the date was a CRIME SCENE
he brought his MOTHER. to a first date. she ordered for him
and then he asked if my salary was 'family compatible' I am going to walk into the sea
As gripping as this is, I have questions. Mainly: who is this.
I can confidently say I have never been a Zoya.
Though for the record, the sea seems like an overreaction. The mother, however, is a valid reason.
oh my god. you're a real stranger. who read ALL of that

options.text: Roast him back. He started it.

messages.text: wrong number. delete this. we never spoke. i was never here
'never been a Zoya' is the most tragic thing anyone has admitted to me and I dated a man who claps when the plane lands
Interesting. Most people google the number before insulting a stranger this confidently.
Don't. It's more fun this way.

scenePanel.caption: 11:47 PM. You should put the phone down. You are not going to put the phone down.

messages.text: why would I google a random number. who ARE you
Someone whose night you just made significantly less boring. Goodnight, crime scene survivor.
GIRL. new number who dis. also HOW WAS THE DATE
